books/checkpoint-summary-leases.lisp:
; Query/loader leases retain exact adopted catalog identity across yields.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "std/util/bstar" :dir :system)
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-state")
(include-book "runs")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-source-word (row i fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
  (natp row) (< row (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)) (natp i) (< i 8))))
 (case i
  (0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-0 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (1 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-1 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (2 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-2 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (3 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-3 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (4 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-4 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (5 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-5 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (6 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-6 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (otherwise (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-7 row fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))))
(defun fn2-run-installed-hash-word (row i fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)
  (natp row) (< row (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)) (natp i) (< i 8))))
 (case i
  (0 (fn2-run-installed-hash-0 row fn2-run-installed))
  (1 (fn2-run-installed-hash-1 row fn2-run-installed))
  (2 (fn2-run-installed-hash-2 row fn2-run-installed))
  (3 (fn2-run-installed-hash-3 row fn2-run-installed))
  (4 (fn2-run-installed-hash-4 row fn2-run-installed))
  (5 (fn2-run-installed-hash-5 row fn2-run-installed))
  (6 (fn2-run-installed-hash-6 row fn2-run-installed))
  (otherwise (fn2-run-installed-hash-7 row fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-source-hash-equal (i e r fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed) :measure (nfix (- 8 (nfix i)))
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)
  (natp i) (<= i 8) (natp e) (< e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
  (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))))
 (or (>= (nfix i) 8)
  (and (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-source-word e i fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-hash-word r i fn2-run-installed))
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-source-hash-equal (+ 1 (nfix i)) e r fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-run-source-p (r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
             (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (and (< 0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (= (fn2-run-installed-physical r fn2-run-installed) 1)
      (= (fn2-run-installed-catalog-tag r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      (= (mod (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-storage-extent-units*) 0)
      (let ((e (floor (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-storage-extent-units*)))
       (and (< e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-tag e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-schema e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rank e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-wire-run r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (+ (fn2-checkpoint-summary-priority-base 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rank e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)) (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-top e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-entries e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-entries r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-epoch e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-epoch r fn2-run-installed))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-allocation e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed))
            (fn2-checkpoint-summary-source-hash-equal 0 e r fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)))))
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-run-current-p (r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
             (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-run-source-p r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
      (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applied*)
      (= (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)))
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-current-p (lease kind owner generation
 fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-installed)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
  (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (and (natp lease) (< lease (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-live lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) 1)
      (equal kind (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-kind lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (equal owner (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-slot lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (equal generation (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-gen lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (< 0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      (member (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)
       (list *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applied* *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-retiring*))
      (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-tag lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      (< (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-run-row lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (let ((e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-extent lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)))
       (and (< e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
            (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-tag e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
            (posp (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))))))

(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-acquire (r lease kind owner generation
 fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-installed)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
  (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp lease) (< lease (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
                    (posp kind) (unsigned-byte-p 8 kind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 owner) (unsigned-byte-p 60 generation)))
       (mv :source 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      ; An existing query owns the immutable catalog source, even after its
      ; former installed row retires or is reused for another run.
      ((when (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-live lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) 1))
       (mv (if (and (equal (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-run-row lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) r)
                     (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-current-p lease kind owner generation fn2-checkpoint-summary
                      fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-run-installed)) :ok :busy)
           (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-extent lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      ((unless (fn2-checkpoint-summary-run-current-p r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed))
       (mv :source 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (e (floor (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-storage-extent-units*))
      (n (+ 1 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 32 n)) (mv :exhausted 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
      (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-put lease (live 1) (run-row r) (extent e)
       (tag (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)) (owner-kind kind) (owner-slot owner) (owner-gen generation)))
      (fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-lease-count 0 n fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
  (mv :ok e fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)))
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-release (lease kind owner generation fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))))
 (if (not (and (< 0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary))
               (natp lease) (< lease (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
               (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-live lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) 1)
               (equal kind (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-kind lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
               (equal owner (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-slot lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
               (equal generation (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-owner-gen lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
               (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-tag lease fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
               (posp (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))))
     (mv :owner fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
  (let* ((fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-set-live lease 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))
         (fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-lease-count 0 (- (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 1) fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
   (mv :ok fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases))))

; Closing blocks new source acquisition; already acquired queries retain their
; immutable source until their exact owner/generation releases it.
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-retire-begin (fn2-checkpoint-summary)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-checkpoint-summary :guard (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
 (if (not (and (< 0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary))
               (or (member (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)
                    (list *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applied* *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-retiring*))
                   (and (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-captured*)
                        (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-installed 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 0)
                        (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 0)))))
     (mv :source fn2-checkpoint-summary)
  (let ((fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-phase 0 *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-retiring* fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
   (mv :retiring fn2-checkpoint-summary))))
books/checkpoint-summary-retire.lisp:
; Physical rows retain no global cache ownership. Free only after their exact
; catalog promise remains held. Immutable query leases survive row reuse;
; only final promise/catalog release waits for every such lease to drain.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "std/util/bstar" :dir :system)
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-leases")
(include-book "checkpoint-cbase-identity")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-retire-row (r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-cbase-holds fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-checkpoint-cbase-holds fn2-run-installed)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary)
             (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
             (fn2-checkpoint-cbase-holds-wfp fn2-checkpoint-cbase-holds)
             (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (fn2-checkpoint-cbase-promised-p fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-cbase-holds)
                    (member-equal (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)
                     (list *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applied* *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-retiring*))
                    (fn2-checkpoint-summary-run-source-p r fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed)
                    (= (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-retired*)))
       (mv :source fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (posp (fn2-checkpoint-summary-installed 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
       (mv :coverage fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed))
      ((mv free-code fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-free-physical r fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (eq free-code :ok)) (mv free-code fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-installed 0
       (- (fn2-checkpoint-summary-installed 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 1) fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
  (mv :retired fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed)))
